abstract: Envato's inaugural global survey of 1,780 creative professionals examines how AI is reshaping creative workflows. Finds near-universal adoption (49% daily use) but significant preparedness gaps, with 69% of creatives feeling unprepared for an AI-driven industry. One in three expect design roles to transform within the year.
keyFindings: 49% of creatives use AI daily for client work, with 50% using it significantly more than six months ago
69% of creatives don't feel fully prepared for an AI-driven creative industry
1 in 3 expect design roles to transform this year
58% have used AI in client work without disclosing it to clients
45% say AI boosts speed and experimentation
Agency owners lead in daily AI usage at 58%, compared to 48% for freelancers
methodology: Survey of 1,780 global creative professionals across every discipline, generation, and geography, supplemented with interviews with AI creative leaders. Published November 2025.
qualifiers: Self-reported survey data from creative professionals. Covers adoption and sentiment, not direct employment or displacement metrics. Global sample, not US-specific. Role 'transformation' does not necessarily mean elimination.
